ns2:section.sectionText: This section will include all personal finance elements of a traditional ACE 240 section and address personal finance issues in an era of social distancing, staying at home and spring 2021 financial markets. All sessions will be ONLINE. Lectures will occur online Monday/Wednesday 3:00 pm - 4:20 pm. While attendance at lectures is not required as all lectures are archived, students are strongly encouraged to attend. Students are required to login and use Moodle in order to complete this course.
